description: List items in a specific column of a DragApp board. Call list_columns first to get column IDs — they are strings like "Label_1", not numbers. A column can mix three item types: email threads (have `threadId`/`from`/`subject`), task cards (have `cardId`/`title`/`status`), and WhatsApp conversations (have `cardId`/`contact`). Use `cardId` with get_card / update_card / move_card, or with the whatsapp tools for WhatsApp items.

boardId.description: The board ID to list threads from

columnId.description: The column ID string (e.g. "Label_1") — use list_columns to find available IDs

name: list_threads
title: List threads
